g.text: 53 x 83 mm; TP21 removed; existing J1 ground contacts retained

g.desc: 53 x 83 mm; TP21 removed; existing J1 ground contacts retained

g.text: Power / I/O / startup accepted for this schematic pass; actual LDO assembly ground return remains unverified.

g.desc: Power / I/O / startup accepted for this schematic pass; actual LDO assembly ground return remains unverified.

g.text: Bank64 carries our ASIC signals. FPGA I/O setting: LVCMOS18.

g.desc: Bank64 carries our ASIC signals. FPGA I/O setting: LVCMOS18.

g.text: C47 / C48: input bypass. L14 + C49 / C50: output filter. R77 / R78 + C54: feedback.

g.desc: C47 / C48: input bypass. L14 + C49 / C50: output filter. R77 / R78 + C54: feedback.

g.text: XEM exports 1.8 V at MC2 pins 75 / 77 / 79. No additional regulator.

g.desc: XEM exports 1.8 V at MC2 pins 75 / 77 / 79. No additional regulator.

g.text: VREFP directly connects to module GNDADC for internal reference; GNDADC stays separate from DGND.

g.desc: VREFP directly connects to module GNDADC for internal reference; GNDADC stays separate from DGND.

g.text: 2 3.3 V SUPPLY FOR THE EXISTING LDO BOARD

g.desc: 2 3.3 V SUPPLY FOR THE EXISTING LDO BOARD

g.text: 12 V -> BRK converter -> JP1 -> LDO J1 pins 1 / 2

g.desc: 12 V -> BRK converter -> JP1 -> LDO J1 pins 1 / 2

g.text: 12 V enters J4 and becomes VDCIN.

g.desc: 12 V enters J4 and becomes VDCIN.

g.text: VDCIN powers the XEM through MC1.

g.desc: VDCIN powers the XEM through MC1.

g.text: U10 / L14 make BUCK_3V3; JP1 connects it to LDO_3V3.

g.desc: U10 / L14 make BUCK_3V3; JP1 connects it to LDO_3V3.

g.text: XEM 1.8 V directly feeds all four FPGA banks; ASIC supplies stay on the LDO board.

g.desc: XEM 1.8 V directly feeds all four FPGA banks; ASIC supplies stay on the LDO board.

g.text: External regulated 12 V - selected for BRK converter. Center positive.

g.desc: External regulated 12 V - selected for BRK converter. Center positive.

g.text: C53: bootstrap. C55: soft start. C56: bias bypass. R75: always-on enable; XEM_PG link omitted.

g.desc: C53: bootstrap. C55: soft start. C56: bias bypass. R75: always-on enable; XEM_PG link omitted.

g.text: MC1 VDCIN: 91 / 93 / 95 / 97 / 99. Power footprints transferred; copper routing pending.

g.desc: MC1 VDCIN: 91 / 93 / 95 / 97 / 99. Power footprints transferred; copper routing pending.

g.text: Howard relays Gerald: supply 3.3 V; the LDO board handles stimulation power.

g.desc: Howard relays Gerald: supply 3.3 V; the LDO board handles stimulation power.

g.text: Carrier boundary: existing LDO_3V3 feed. No extra stimulation converters selected.

g.desc: Carrier boundary: existing LDO_3V3 feed. No extra stimulation converters selected.

g.text: Older saved LDO source has separate J15 / J8 inputs; verify the matching revision.

g.desc: Older saved LDO source has separate J15 / J8 inputs; verify the matching revision.

g.text: Owner-reported boundary recorded; the older source is not proof of 3.3 V-only operation.

g.desc: Owner-reported boundary recorded; the older source is not proof of 3.3 V-only operation.

g.text: LDO_3V3 feeds LDO J1 pins 1 and 2.

g.desc: LDO_3V3 feeds LDO J1 pins 1 and 2.
